# netskopebwan_snmp_user (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single object is addressed either by its id...
data "netskopebwan_snmp_user" "by_id" {
  id = "6501f0c2e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6"
}

# ...or by a filter, which has to match exactly one object.
data "netskopebwan_snmp_user" "by_filter" {
  filter = "name eq \"example\""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Filter selecting the object to read, in the API's filter syntax, e.g. `name eq "corporate"`. It has to match exactly one object. Exactly one of `id` or `filter` is required.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the object to read. Exactly one of `id` or `filter` is required.

### Read-Only

- `auth_protocol` (String) Authentication (HMAC) protocol Must be one of: `sha1`, `sha224`, `sha256`, `sha384`, `sha512`.
- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `modified_at` (String)
- `modified_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modified_by))
- `name` (String) SNMPv3 USM username, unique per tenant
- `privacy_protocol` (String) Privacy (encryption) protocol Must be one of: `aes128`, `aes256`.
- `security_level` (String) USM security level determining which credentials apply Must be one of: `no_auth_no_priv`, `auth_no_priv`, `auth_priv`.
